description: This file defines the CategoriesScreen component for managing categories within a notes application. It includes UI elements for listing, adding, renaming, and deleting categories, and interacts with a repository service for data operations.

methods.name: CategoriesScreen
methods.description: Main React component for the categories management screen, handling state and UI rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads categories from the repository and updates state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new category with the name specified in 'newName' and reloads the list.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an existing category given its ID, prompting the user for a new name.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes a category after user confirmation.
